title: Thai-Style Poffertjes Wrap
description: A fusion of traditional Thai flavors with Dutch poffertjes, wrapped in a crispy treat.

ingredients.name: goey
ingredients.notes: sweet and sticky sauce (e.g. honey, maple syrup)

ingredients.name: zesty
ingredients.notes: Thai-style peanut sauce (or substitute with peanut butter)

instructions: 1. Cook poffertjes according to package instructions.
2. Warm the tortilla by wrapping it in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
3. Spread a thin layer of zesty sauce on the tortilla.
4. Arrange 4-5 poffertjes on one half of the tortilla.
5. Drizzle gooey sauce over the poffertjes.
6. Sprinkle crushed peanuts over the top.
7. Fold the tortilla in half to enclose the filling.
8. Serve immediately and drizzle with sugar, if desired.
